source.citation: Waller, V. (1999). Relations entre composition des bétons, exothermie en cours de prise et résistance en compression. PhD thesis, École Nationale des Ponts et Chaussées. HAL tel-01223803.

transcription.note: Checked on 2026-10-04 against the thesis (HAL tel-01223803v1, 324 pages, with a text layer): it does not contain the slag time that this package had attributed to it since its first release of the Waller law. It names a slag once, p. 219 (PDF page 246, annex D, among the mineral additions an adiabatic test may contain), and gives no kinetic parameter for one. The value of 100 d is therefore not recorded here, and no slag parameter set is shipped.

notes: The sigmoid law and the fly-ash parameters the package uses are those of Lavergne et al. (2018, p. 42), adjusted to the results of this thesis; see data/literature/Lavergne2018.json.
